title: Not That Great
text: Not That Great. This really doesn't look a lot like the picture as far as color. It is a space suit silver metallic color. The handles are well attached. It doesn't keep it's shape very well. There is a sewn in wire around the top that is I guess supposed to help keep it round, but doesn't. Somehow I was expecting something sturdier and heavier and more functional. It will find a use, but not where anyone can see it.
